feishuDriveHint: "Drive" source can only list "My Space". Feishu "My Documents Library" is a separate personal module with no public Open API yet. To sync a shared space or a specific folder, paste its link (or folder token) above.
feishuSearchPlaceholder: Empty = list ALL documents; or type a keyword (max 30 chars)
feishuSearchHint: Empty keyword = recursively aggregate ALL accessible documents (every Wiki node + Drive My Space) into a flat list. A keyword calls Feishu's search API, which is user-scoped (the app identity often gets nothing — use User identity). The right side shows the owner or location.
feishuSearchEmpty: No documents found (the app may lack the search:docs:read scope)
